caption: The image is a monochromatic drawing of a decorative plate. The central area of the plate features a detailed scene depicting a paved street with a row of buildings on the right side, including a large multi-story structure with many windows. In the background, there is a church or cathedral with a tall spire, positioned among smaller buildings. On the left, there is a cluster of trees behind a wrought iron fence that runs parallel to the street. In the foreground, three figures—two adults and one child—are walking or standing on the sidewalk, with one adult holding the child’s hand. The border of the plate is adorned with a repeating pattern of large, detailed oak leaves and acorns, set against a dotted, textured background. The entire composition is rendered in shades of black, white, and gray.
title: Plate - "Park Theatre, NY"
